claim: Sample mode works without an account, uses only isolated demo storage, never calls the private board API, and resets cleanly.
where: landing action, demo banner, README, privacy
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; edit the roster; inspect storage and requests; reset

claim: Reset restores the shipped sample with exactly two sessions, three learners, four problems, and four attempts.
sandbox: fresh demo; change the roster; reset; inspect the isolated sample record and visible roster

claim: The board supports a private group of 6–12 learners and limits the roster to 12 aliases.
sandbox: fresh demo; verify the range copy; add aliases through the UI to 12; assert a thirteenth is rejected

claim: The board records partial learner attempts, strategy status, and private facilitator notes.
where: landing page, attempt workbench, README, catalog description
sandbox: fresh demo; edit an attempt and private note; save and reload

claim: The printable session recap includes learner thinking and leaves private facilitator notes out.
where: landing page, recap, README, catalog description
sandbox: fresh demo; save distinct public thinking and private note; open printable recap

claim: Settings exports the complete board record as JSON.
sandbox: fresh demo; download JSON; parse and assert learners, sessions, attempts, private note, and attachment list

claim: Sample mode reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: fresh 390 px browser context; wait for service worker control; go offline and reload

claim: The public landing page and sample flow load no analytics, ads, remote fonts, or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: record every request across landing, sample entry, and sample navigation; assert only current origin

claim: Private board data requires the signed-in Microsoft owner, while learner records use aliases without email fields.
sandbox: fresh server; request private API anonymously; inspect signed-out and sample roster forms

claim: With only PORT supplied, first boot creates ./data/board.db, ./data/uploads, and a private 48-character adult setup code, using the documented Microsoft authority; documented environment overrides are honored.
where: README run locally and optional configuration
sandbox: fresh temporary working directory; launch the built server with an empty environment except PATH and PORT; inspect health, files, permissions, and startup log

claim: The container contract uses a non-root user, PORT 8080, /data persistence, and build identity returned by /health.
sandbox: inspect the production Docker recipe and query /health on the isolated server started on its supplied PORT

claim: Read routes use a 40-request burst and writes use an 8-request burst; limited responses include 429 and Retry-After.
sandbox: fresh server; concurrent read and write bursts from separate fixed forwarded IPs

claim: This release has no paid plan, checkout, organization controls, or extra storage tier.
where: landing facts, strategy page, README, privacy, terms, scope deviation
sandbox: fresh public page and terms page; assert the explicit scope statement and absence of a checkout link

claim: Four free reusable strategy prompts add to an attempt and remain after saving and reloading.
where: landing release scope, strategy page, attempt workbench, README, terms
sandbox: fresh demo; open Strategy prompts; count four prompts; choose Draw a diagram; save and reload the attempt

claim: The signed-in owner can delete the complete private board.
sandbox: fresh SQLite directory; claim board, add a session, confirm full deletion, assert server is unconfigured
